nest-starter.description: Generate a NestJS + TypeORM (PostgreSQL) monorepo: apps/api, libs/common, libs/database (--apps api,bot,worker adds those add-ons)

nest-crud.description: Generate a CRUD resource: entity in libs/database, DTOs/service/controller/module in apps/api for admin/<name>

seed.description: Add a seed file in libs/database/src/seeds and register it (npm run seed -- <name>)

openapi-client.description: Add an openapi-generator client target (typescript-angular, dart-dio, typescript-fetch): openapitools.json and api:generate scripts

worker.description: Add apps/worker: cron jobs with @nestjs/schedule (other add-ons register their jobs in it)

bot.description: Add apps/bot: Telegram bot on telegraf (BOT_TOKEN, empty = disabled)

upload.description: Add media_files uploads: local or S3/MinIO storage, type/size checks, admin/files routes, public files/:id with ETag and Range, optional thumbnails, orphan cleanup

upload-tus.description: Add resumable (tus) uploads on top of upload: --engine tusd (docker service + hooks, default) or node (@tus/server in the api); token and limit checks on create, magic-byte check and media_files row on finish, worker cleanup

api-logs.description: Add server_api_logs: global request log interceptor with secret masking, x-request-id, @LogPayment(), logCron(), admin routes and retention

sms.description: Add SmsModule / SmsService.send(phone, text) in libs/common/src/sms (eskiz | log)

mail.description: Add MailModule / MailService.send({ to, subject, html, text }) and templates in libs/common/src/mail (resend | smtp | log)

auth-client.description: Add client (app user) auth: users, sessions, UserGuard, @CurrentUser(), client/auth/* (--methods phone,email,google,apple,telegram) and admin/users

ai.description: Add AiService (OpenRouter / Gemini over fetch: generate, stream, vision, json, image), ai_logs with tokens and cost, admin stats; --chat: client SSE chat; --quota: per-user limits

notifications.description: Add notifications + notification_campaigns: NotificationService.send() (save, then FCM push in chunks of 500), --channels telegram,email, client/notifications, admin broadcast and campaigns, push retry in the worker
